origin.description: Plot two series against a shared x, with a second y axis.
origin.usage: plotyy(x1, y1, x2, y2, gridp=TRUE, box_col='grey', type='l', lwd=1, lty=1, xlab='x', ylab='y', main='', col_y1='navy', col_y2='maroon')
origin.details: The two plotted series, squares and square roots. R time is that series, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Plot two series against a shared x, with a second y axis.
origin.example: { pdf(file.path(tempdir(), "p.pdf")); x1 <- 1:5; y1 <- x1^2; x2 <- 1:5; y2 <- sqrt(x2); plotyy(x1,y1,x2,y2); dev.off(); c(y1, y2) }
